# The surface of RustCall 0.7.0 that a file written by `write_bindings_to_file`
# can reach, recorded from the v0.7.0 release. v0.7.0 is the oldest release of
# bindings format 0.7, and every file of that format must load
# under it (#531). One line per name: the name, then one entry per
# method, `arity|keywords`: `n` positional arguments, or `n+` for a
# vararg method taking at least n; the keywords it accepts, `*` for any.
# A name with no entries is not callable (a module, a constant).
